'''Marqo's''' was a renowned eatery in [[D'larah]], on the planet [[Demophon]]. It was owned by [[Cradjius Lucern]], who took over after its founder fled before the impending [[Demophon system/Legends|Demophon system]] [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Lucern decided to capitalize on Marqo's reputation as a luxurious [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], keeping the name as he transformed it into a dark and moody gambling hall and [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Many of the people of D'larah saw Marqo's as a chance for escape, hoping to win enough gambling to buy passage off world.
